results.oldDesc:
The flow I built to take a GTA 6 channel to millions of views — one
prompt, one loop. Research that used to take a full day now takes a
sentence: seven-day scans, competitor outliers, then a full package —
story, storyboard, script, titles, thumbnail text, description, tags,
chapters — uploaded, scheduled, and commented automatically.

Real screenshots, real queue, real channel. Free tiers listed on
screen with their limits (10,000 API units/day, 50 Flow credits/day,
6 uploads/day). Millions is the goal, not the claim — this is the
method. No income promises: a workflow story, not a course.
